notes: Accessed via Chrome connector only, one dedicated tab, no proxies. robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (generic SEO disallows on /checkout/, /customer/, /catalogsearch/, /catalog/category/view/, plus explicit 'Allow: /*.html$' for product/category pages) -- fully accessible. UNLIKE the prior Home Decor pass (archive c307, notes/263.md), which found this brand as textiles-only with furniture entirely out of scope, the site now has a real top-level FURNITURE department (mega-menu item + homepage 'Discover by Category' tile, href /furniture.html) with 168 items on the aggregate listing page. Tree source: union of the header mega-menu dropdown (6 links: Sofas, Armchairs, Coffee Tables, Side Tables, Consoles & More, Bench) and sitemap.xml's /furniture/ entries (6 links: armchairs, sofa, stool-pouf, coffee-table, console, side-table -- includes stool-pouf which is NOT in the nav, and omits bench which IS in the nav), per the mandatory union rule -- 7 distinct leaf categories total, each independently confirmed HTTP 200 with an h1 matching the intended node (Sofa, Armchair, Coffee Table, Side Table, Console, Bench, Stool & Pouf). All 7 are flat leaves directly under Furniture; the site has no deeper sub-grouping (no Seating/Tables/Bedroom intermediate nodes), so 'Furniture' is the only grouping row. Qty method: this site is a client-rendered Magento/VSF storefront -- a raw same-origin fetch() of the HTML returns no product data (SPA hydrates client-side with no discoverable product-count API in performance/resource entries), so qty was read from the rendered DOM's 'ITEMS N' badge on each category page after navigation+hydration (rule 4 priority 1, rendered listing header), one navigation per category, ~1.5s settle wait each. Sanity check: the number changed per category (29/43/18/25/9/10/3), ruling out a constant site-wide total. IMPORTANT DISCREPANCY, disclosed per Rule 4: the 7 leaf ITEMS values sum to 137, but the parent /furniture.html aggregate page itself shows ITEMS 168 -- a gap of 31. Investigated by paginating the parent listing (Load More, 4 clicks reaching ~49 unique product tiles before the button stopped appearing -- infinite-scroll/lazy-load likely requires viewport-intersection triggers beyond what repeated clicks reproduced) and spot-checking one distinctive title: 'Fernwood Ottoman' (saritahanda.com/fernwood-ottoman.html) appears on the parent Furniture listing but is confirmed NOT present in the Stool & Pouf category (which lists only Alderon Foot Stool and 2x Jona Foot Stool -- 3 items, matching its own ITEMS 3 header) or any other of the 7 categorized nodes checked. This is the same 'delisted from nav/sitemap but still live and purchasable' orphaned-SKU pattern already documented for this company's Decor department in notes/263.md (orphaned t-light holders, orphaned lamp/light products). Given that precedent and the site's demonstrably unreliable search/enumeration (per notes/263.md), the ~31-item gap is reported as a separate flagged null row rather than guessed, invented, or silently folded into any one category's count. Excluded per scope: all Soft Furnishings/textiles, Bath & Wellness, Decor department items (vases/sculpture/candle holders/mirrors -- Wall Decor/Decorative Accessories territory, already covered by the prior Home Decor pass), and the 'New Arrivals > Furniture' / 'The Final Few > Furniture' filter views (marketing/filter pages, never real categories per Rule 3).
